(i) You are Olay Reid and you attended a meeting on 20 April 2011. While you were away, a message from Evelyn Thames of the Examinations Council, 10 Main Street, St. Michael, Barbados, Telephone: 246-207-1733 was received by the secretary, Ms Grace Powell, at 10:00 a.m.

The message states that your travel itinerary has been prepared and will be sent to you shortly. You will be traveling on West Indian Airlines 615 which will depart from Kingston, Jamaica at 2:00 p.m. on 6 December 2011. However, you should present yourself at the check-in counter with your passport at least 2 hours before your flight time. Ms Thames says that your travel will be processed in the usual manner by the airline. You should bear in mind that although your airline reservation has been confirmed, it is your responsibility to check with the airline, preferably the day prior to your departure, to ascertain whether there has been any change to your booking. You will return to Jamaica from Barbados on West Indian Airlines 616 on 10 December 2011.

Use the Message Form provided on the enclosed sheet to record the RELEVANT points of the message. (6 marks)
